visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-width 16x9 slides with split headline (class name left, tagline right), slide count, EXPLORE button, image thumbnail navigation bottom-right.

contentPattern.structure: per slide: image | heading + tagline + CTA link | optional thumbnail label (defaults to first word of heading)

suitableFor: product-line sliders with image thumbnail navigation
full-width image slides with headline, tagline and single CTA
notSuitableFor: card carousels showing several items at once
